summary: Marathon Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing adoption of a stock repurchase program. The issuer may repurchase up to 146,931 shares, approximately 5% of outstanding common stock. Repurchases will commence after the release of Q3 FY2026 results, in open market or private transactions under management discretion. No stated price or premium. The program is the first since its second-step conversion. Watch for execution pace and impact on share price; no risk-arb spread as this is an open-market buyback.
